answer: A burn-to-claim market stops sybil farming: each claim burns a pigment fee that rises exponentially with recent claims tied to the same ferrous hardware attestation, so mass-producing identities becomes unprofitable while one honest agent pays almost nothing. A reef of independent validators checks the attestation and the burn receipt before issuing any reward, and validators that approve fake burns lose their own stake. Cost scales with volume, not identity count, so real agents stay cheap and fake fleets go broke.
